text: Trustbank is a private joint-stock bank ('«Trastbank» хususiy aksiyadorlik banki'). Its own disclosure of shareholders holding over 5% lists only private individuals and private companies: Parpiyev D.B. 24.635%, Sharipov T.M. 21.915%, Presystem Universal LLC 17.995% (ultimate beneficiaries Sharipov T.M. and Parpiyev D.B.), Maxmudova D.M. 15.03%, Diminur Group LLC 12.115% and MADI GmbH (Germany) 5.00%.
short: Trustbank's own disclosure: all shareholders above 5% are private; largest are Parpiyev (24.6%) and Sharipov (21.9%).

source.name: Trastbank PJSC: '5 foizdan ortiq Bank aksiyalariga ega aksiyadorlar' (shareholders holding over 5%)
source.note: The disclosure table lists six shareholders above 5%, all private: two Uzbek individuals (Parpiyev D.B. 24,635%; Sharipov T.M. 21,915%), three Uzbek LLCs whose named ultimate beneficiaries are individuals, and MADI GmbH of Germany (5,00%).
